描述_EN: in areas where the yellowish glaze runs thin it tends to burn to an opaque chocolate brown colour. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this jar was an example of a mass-produced type to be found in most households.
描述_ZN: 在淡黄色釉层较薄的地方，它往往会烧成不透明的巧克力色。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个罐子是在大多数家庭中发现的大量生产的类型的例子。
